title: 第12章 转危为安
content_zh:
第12章转危为安
只是这厢房里的两个少年都不知道，就在上药的时候，那窗户纸被人用手指捅了一个窟窿，一只眼睛朝里头默默地观察。
片刻之后，眼睛的主人收回了目光，这主人正是在此负责医治的太医。
等张安世一走，太医连忙入室，大抵了解了情况后，便似乎胸有成竹了。
到了傍晚，太医又被诏入宫中。
朱棣神色显得疲惫，却还是强打精神：“病情如何？”
“陛下……”这御医顿了顿，道：“臣……实在惭愧，虽下了几味猛药，可是却眼看着张公子病入膏盲……不过……不过……”
朱棣拧眉看着他：“不过什么。”
“臣等的药，若想要做到药到病除，却也未必没有可能，只是现在……却为时已晚。”
“这是何故？”朱棣的脸色越来越不善。
“怪只怪张公子误信他人，今日……居然听信了一个少年的话，胡乱下药。”
“少年……下药……”朱棣的脸色骤然变了：“郭得甘？”
“臣不知此人的名姓，只是那药……臣后头检验过，可谓闻所未闻，陛下……现在张公子病成了这个样子，胡乱用药，后果不堪设想。”
朱棣身躯不禁颤抖：“退下去吧。”
御医长长松了口气，总算……可以蒙混过关了，到时那张軏一旦死了，那就真怪不得太医院，一切罪过可以推到那个少年上头。
次日，朱棣一宿未睡。
等到宦官至寝殿为朱棣更衣的时候，却见朱棣披头散发，神色暗淡了许多。
朱棣的眼睛通红，一直在朱棣身边陪侍的宦官亦失哈道：“陛下的神色不好，是下头的奴婢有什么过失吗？”
亦失哈是海西女真人，很早就被送进大明宫廷，成为了宦官。
其实在明初的时候，绝大多数的宦官都来自番邦，譬如乌斯藏的侯显，女真的亦失哈，还有安南国的阮安，除此之外，宦官和宫女的主要来源还有朝鲜等国。

朱棣抬头看了亦失哈一眼，亦失哈向来忠心耿耿，当值也是处处小心，见亦失哈关切，朱棣道：“朕一宿未睡，又梦见了张世美，世美当初为了救朕于万军之中，慨然战死，如今他的遗孤，朕非但没有照料好，却还因为朕的缘故，将他打成这个样子，生死未卜，倘若张軏真有什么闪失，世美有灵，百年之后朕有什么面目去见他啊。”
说着，朱棣眼眶更红。
自从登基做了天子，朱棣已经很少显露出自己的情绪了，可每每涉及到了名将张玉，却总是禁不住流泪满襟。
亦失哈自然知晓朱棣的心思，只能安慰道：“陛下，人有祸福，富贵在天。”
朱棣道：“朕敬天法祖，可事涉张軏，朕便逆天而行，也绝不可轻言放弃，亦失哈，你随朕再去一趟张家吧，听说……听说……他快不成了。”
亦失哈本想说，今日还有一场朝会，大臣们已经在午门外候见了。
可这话很快吞了回去，他点点头：“奴婢遵旨。”
朱棣先召了御医来，负责张軏的御医姓许，许太医如丧考妣的样子，昨天夜里，他又诊断过病情，毒疮显然已经难以逆转了。
朱棣看他的时候，让他心里发毛，为了防范未然，给自己买一个保险，许太医一再小心翼翼地表示：“原本施救，对症下药，虽未必能保全性命，却也可使张家小公子多活几日，只是张家公子的朋友……”
朱棣无言。
这一路，朱棣都是便衣骑马而行，脑子里所掠过的，却都是张玉的影子，心中潸然，又不禁泪下。
至张府，进入张家时候，居然一个踉跄，绊到了门槛，身子打了个趔趄。
亦失哈忙是搀扶住，也不由得哭丧着脸道：“陛下平日龙行虎步，何等雄壮，今日……今日……陛下要节哀。”
朱棣无奈地摆摆手，快接近张軏卧房的时候，朱棣脚步踌躇起来，此时内心矛盾，既想立即探视，可心里又担心见到半死不活的张軏。
良久，他终是叹了口气：“朕对不住世美……朕对不住……”
说到这里，朱棣的声音戛然而止。
却是听到卧房那边有人发出杀猪一般的歌声：”我去炸学校，老师不知道。点了火赶紧跑。轰隆一声……“
朱棣：“……”
又听这声音道：“哈哈，我大哥是不是很有才，这歌真带劲，也只有大哥才能想出来。好啦，别在此总像木头一样，将那碗粥拿过来给我吃……”
他的大哥……张辅？

他们想炸什么来着？
朱棣加急脚步，冲了进去。
一看，见张軏依旧还趴在床榻上，却是精神颇足，呼噜噜地喝着粥。
朱棣：“……”
似乎因为伤口还是有些疼的，所以趴着的张軏不便拿粥勺子，于是便将碗搁在自己的榻上，嘴巴伸进去，似小猪拱槽一样吸食，那粥水同时还在冒着泡泡。
似乎他也听到了动静，错愕地抬头，见着了朱棣，于是方才欢快的样子便无影无踪了，变成了一种无所适从，想要昏厥，却又发现脑袋下的粥碗碍事，令他没办法歪了脖子耷拉下去的苦恼。
于是，他吸了吸鼻子，鼻上似乎也沾了粥水，这一呼吸之间，居然直接吹出了一个泡泡来。
朱棣：“……”
张軏：“……”
亦失哈道：“陛下，陛下，他……他……似乎……”
朱棣这才想起了什么，眼神甚是复杂，转瞬之间，焦灼、惊喜却又愤怒的神色在眼底掠过，想要张口，却是词穷，等他终于反应过来，才呵斥道：“你兄长何在？”
张軏道：“兄长见我无恙，怕……怕陛下担心，去宫里道喜了，怎么，兄长没有撞见陛下？”
“你娘呢？”
张軏一脸愁容：“昨夜还哭哭啼啼的在榻前守了一宿呢，清早见我起来无恙了，又转了脸色，说怎么生了我这么一个憨货，骂了一顿，便不踩我啦。”
朱棣又陷入了沉默，却大步流星地到了张軏面前，掀开了被褥，一看，这本是生了毒疮的伤口，居然有愈合的征兆。
他又伸手摸了摸张軏的脑袋，似乎也不见高烧了，这才真正长松了口气：“怎的一夜之间便好了？”
张軏此时才露出了得意的样子：“当然是因为我大哥的灵丹妙药了。”
此时，朱棣想到居然不再是张辅，而是另一个人：“是郭得甘？”
“……”张軏沉默了片刻：“是他。”
朱棣一脸狐疑。

没想到，那个叫郭得甘，竟真有灵药？
心中一颗大石落下，顿时觉得浑身轻松，此前他遇到郭得甘的时候，并没有将那浑少年放在心上。
说难听一些，在朱棣心目之中，那少年不啻是蝼蚁一般。
只是现在，这个少年却不由得浮现在朱棣的脑海，不经意生出一个念头……倒是多亏了此子。
朱棣抬眼，看了一眼张軏，心里又难受了，这几日一想到这个小子，朱棣便百爪挠心，说不出的难受和心疼。
可现在见他病好转了不少，这一副畏畏缩缩却又带着藏不住的憨样，于是朱棣的目光便变成了嫌恶。
content_en:
Chapter 12 Turning the Danger into Safety
It's just that the two teenagers in this wing didn't know that when they were applying the medicine, someone poked a hole in the window paper with their fingers, and they looked inside silently with one eye.
After a moment, the owner of the eyes withdrew his gaze. This owner was the imperial physician responsible for the treatment here.
As soon as Zhang Anshi left, the imperial doctor quickly entered the room. After roughly understanding the situation, he seemed to be confident.
In the evening, the imperial doctor was summoned to the palace again.
Zhu Di looked tired, but still kept his spirits up: "How is your condition?"
"Your Majesty..." The imperial doctor paused and said, "I... I am really ashamed. Although I took a few strong medicines, I saw Mr. Zhang become seriously ill and blind... but... but..."
Zhu Di frowned and looked at him: "Nothing."
"If I want to cure the disease with my medicine, it may not be impossible, but now... it's too late."
"Why is this?" Zhu Di's face became increasingly unkind.
"It's just that Young Master Zhang mistrusted others. Today... he actually listened to a young man and drugged him randomly."
"Young man...drugged..." Zhu Di's expression suddenly changed: "Guo Degan?"
"I don't know this person's name, but the medicine... I have tested it later, and it is unheard of. Your Majesty... Mr. Zhang is now so ill. If he uses medicine indiscriminately, the consequences will be disastrous."
Zhu Di's body couldn't help but tremble: "Get back."
The imperial doctor let out a long sigh of relief. Finally... he could get away with it. Once Zhang Fu dies, the hospital will not be blamed. All the blame can be placed on that young man.
The next day, Zhu Di didn't sleep all night.
When the eunuch went to the bedroom to change Zhu Di's clothes, he saw Zhu Di's hair disheveled and his expression much darker.
Zhu Di's eyes were red, and the eunuch who had been accompanying him said in disbelief: "Your Majesty doesn't look good. Is there anything wrong with the slave below?"
Yi Shiha was a Haixi Jurchen who was sent to the Ming Dynasty court very early and became a eunuch.
In fact, in the early Ming Dynasty, the vast majority of eunuchs came from foreign countries, such as Hou Xian of Uzang, Jurchen Yishiha, and Ruan An of Annan. In addition, the main sources of eunuchs and maids were Korea and other countries.
Zhu Di raised his head and glanced at Yi Shiha. Yi Shiha has always been loyal and careful when on duty. Seeing Yi Shiha's concern, Zhu Di said: "I stayed up all night and dreamed of Zhang Shimei again. Shimei acted so generously to save me from the thousands of armies." He died in the battle. Not only did I fail to take good care of his orphan, but he was beaten into this state because of me. His life and death are uncertain. If Zhang Fu does something wrong and Shimei has a spirit, how can I see him in a hundred years?"
As he spoke, Zhu Di's eyes became even redder.
Since he ascended the throne and became emperor, Zhu Di has rarely shown his emotions, but whenever it comes to the famous general Zhang Yu, he can't help but burst into tears.
Yi Shiha naturally knew Zhu Di's thoughts and could only comfort him: "Your Majesty, people have misfortunes and blessings, but wealth and honor are in heaven."
Zhu Di said: "I respect the Heavenly Patriarch, but the matter involves Zhang Fu, so I will go against the will of heaven, and I will never give up easily. It's also a shame. You can come with me to the Zhang family again. I heard... I heard... he is dying soon."
Yishiha wanted to say that there was another court meeting today, and the ministers were already waiting outside the Meridian Gate.
But he swallowed the words quickly and nodded: "I obey the order."
Zhu Di first summoned the imperial physician. The imperial physician in charge of Zhang Fu was named Xu. Imperial Physician Xu looked like he was mourning. Last night, he diagnosed the condition again. It was obvious that the sores were irreversible.
When Zhu Di looked at him, he felt very nervous. In order to prevent the possibility of the future, he bought an insurance policy for himself. Doctor Xu carefully said again and again: "Original rescue and prescribing the right medicine may not save his life, but it can also make the young master of the Zhang family live for a few more days. He is just a friend of the young master of the Zhang family..."
Zhu Di was speechless.Along the way, Zhu Di was riding in plainclothes, but all that passed through his mind was the shadow of Zhang Yu. His heart was filled with tears, and he couldn't help but cry.
Arriving at Zhang's Mansion, when he entered Zhang's house, he stumbled, tripped over the threshold, and staggered.
Yi Shiha hurriedly supported him, but he couldn't help but said with a mournful face: "Your Majesty usually walks like a dragon or a tiger, how majestic it is. Today... today... Your Majesty wants to express his condolences."
Zhu Di waved his hand helplessly. When he was approaching Zhang Fu's bedroom, Zhu Di hesitated. At this time, he was conflicted. He wanted to visit immediately, but he was worried about seeing the half-dead Zhang Fu.
After a long time, he finally sighed: "I'm sorry for Shimei... I'm sorry..."
At this point, Zhu Di's voice stopped suddenly.
But I heard someone singing a song like killing a pig from the other side of the bedroom: "I'm going to blow up the school. The teacher doesn't know. I lit the fire and ran away. There was a boom..."
Zhu Di: "..."
Hearing this voice again: "Haha, my elder brother is very talented, isn't he? This song is really exciting, and only the elder brother can come up with it. Okay, don't be like a piece of wood here, bring me that bowl of porridge to eat..."
His eldest brother...Zhang Fu?
What do they want to blow up?
Zhu Di quickened his pace and rushed in.
Taking a look, Zhang Fu was still lying on the bed, but he was full of energy and snoring while drinking porridge.
Zhu Di: "..."
It seemed that the wound was still a little painful, so Zhang Fu couldn't hold the porridge spoon while lying down, so he put the bowl on his couch, put his mouth in, and sucked it in like a pig's trough. The porridge water was still bubbling.
It seemed that he had also heard the noise. He raised his head in surprise and saw Zhu Di. The cheerful look just now disappeared and turned into a state of confusion. He wanted to faint, but found that the porridge bowl under his head was in the way, making him unable to tilt his neck and droop down.
So, he sniffed, and his nose seemed to be stained with porridge water. During this breath, a bubble actually blew out.
Zhu Di: "..."
Zhang Fu: "..."
Yi Shiha said: "Your Majesty, Your Majesty, he...he...seems..."
Only then did Zhu Di remember something. His eyes were very complicated. In an instant, a look of anxiety, surprise, and anger flashed through his eyes. He wanted to speak, but he was at a loss for words. When he finally came to his senses, he scolded: "Where is your brother?"
Zhang Fu said: "Brother saw that I was fine. I was afraid... I was afraid that Your Majesty would be worried. I went to the palace to congratulate you. Why didn't I bump into Your Majesty?"
"Where's your mother?"
Zhang Fu had a sad look on his face: "Last night, I stayed in front of the bed crying all night. When he saw that I was fine when I got up early in the morning, he turned around and said why he gave birth to such a fool like me. After scolding me, he stopped stepping on me."
Zhu Di fell into silence again, but strode to Zhang Fu, lifted the quilt, and saw that the wound, which was originally a malignant sore, was showing signs of healing.
He reached out and touched Zhang Fu's head again, and it seemed that the high fever was no longer there. Only then did he heave a sigh of relief: "How come it was cured overnight?"
Zhang Fu showed a proud look at this moment: "Of course it's because of my elder brother's miraculous medicine."
At this time, Zhu Di thought that it was no longer Zhang Fu, but another person: "Is it Guo Degan?"
"..." Zhang Fu was silent for a moment: "It's him."
Zhu Di looked suspicious.
Unexpectedly, that man named Guo Degan actually has a magical medicine?
A big stone fell in his heart, and he suddenly felt relaxed. When he met Guo Degan before, he didn't take the young man seriously.
To put it harshly, in Zhu Di's mind, the young man was nothing more than an ant.
But now, this young man couldn't help but appear in Zhu Di's mind, and an idea came to his mind... It was thanks to this boy.
Zhu Di raised his eyes, glanced at Zhang Fu, and felt uncomfortable again. Thinking of this boy these days, Zhu Di scratched his heart with all his claws., unspeakably uncomfortable and distressed.
But now he saw that his illness had improved a lot, and he was timid but also had a naive look that he couldn't hide, so Zhu Di's eyes turned into disgust.
